name: Kocelovice (Czechia)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly by a yellow stripe into a blue upper fly part and a green lower hoist part.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 24 February 2012 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
